Serious Crime Act 2007

8 (1) Schedule 1 to the Serious Crime Act 2007 (serious offences) is amended as
follows.

(2) In Part 1 (serious offences in Engl and and Wales), after paragraph 1 insert—
“1A An offence under any of the following provisions of the
Psychoactive Substances Act 2016—
(a) section 4 (producing a psychoactive substance);
(b) section 5 (supplying, or offe ring to supply, a psychoactive
substance);
(c) section 7 (possession of psyc hoactive substance with intent
to supply);
(d) section 8 (importing or exporting a psychoactive
substance).”
